prompt: A resident asked when the community center’s rehearsal piano would be restored. The maintenance manager replied, ‘I can’t promise we’ll repair it this spring.’ The notice drafted afterward says, ‘Management has promised not to repair the piano this spring.’ In the notice, the writer has ______.
promptZh: 一位住戶詢問社區中心的排練用鋼琴何時會修好。維護經理回答：「我不能保證我們會在今年春天修理鋼琴。」事後起草的公告寫道：「管理方已承諾，今年春天不會修理鋼琴。」在這份公告裡，撰稿人______。

options.text: changed the expected season without changing the strength of the promise
options.zh: 更改了預計的季節，但沒改變承諾的強度
options.whyZh: 兩個說法都指今年春天；改變的是有沒有承諾，而不是季節。

options.text: turned a refusal to make a commitment into a commitment not to act
options.zh: 把不作承諾改寫成承諾不採取行動
options.whyZh: 原話否定的是能否作出承諾，鋼琴春天仍可能修理。公告把否定移到修理行動本身，變成承諾不修。

options.text: recorded a promise to restore the piano while leaving the timing open
options.zh: 記錄了承諾修理鋼琴，但時間尚未確定
options.whyZh: 經理沒有承諾修理，公告更是寫成承諾不修；兩者都沒有提供這種正面的承諾。

options.text: made the manager’s reply less definite about what will happen this spring
options.zh: 讓經理對今年春天會怎麼做的回答變得更不確定
options.whyZh: 公告作出『春天不會修』的確切承諾，比原本不保證更確定，而不是更不確定。

explanationZh: 原話否定的是能否作出承諾，鋼琴春天仍可能修理。公告把否定移到修理行動本身，變成承諾不修。

vocabulary.note: can’t promise we will do it 否定能作出保證；promise we will not do it 則保證不做。

evidence: A resident asked when the community center’s rehearsal piano would be restored. The maintenance manager replied, ‘I can’t promise we’ll repair it this spring.’ The notice drafted afterward says, ‘Management has promised not to repair the piano this spring.’ In the notice, the writer has turned a refusal to make a commitment into a commitment not to act.
evidenceZh: 一位住戶詢問社區中心的排練用鋼琴何時會修好。維護經理回答：「我不能保證我們會在今年春天修理鋼琴。」事後起草的公告寫道：「管理方已承諾，今年春天不會修理鋼琴。」在這份公告裡，撰稿人把不作承諾改寫成承諾不採取行動。
